capabilities: fetch the README file from a specified GitHub repository
convert HTML content in the README to Markdown
remove unnecessary HTML tags and empty lines
convert relative image URLs to absolute URLs
extras: Installation is manual (place plugin files in the plugins directory); no mention of GitHub API tokens or account requirements.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch a GitHub repository's README and convert it into clean Markdown inside a note.
summary: Imports a GitHub repository's README into the current note, converting HTML to Markdown and fixing images.
